$comment: Generated from the stellar-toml-lint rule registry by apps/pwa/scripts/generate-offline-data.mjs. Do not edit by hand.

rules.description: An anchored asset should describe what backs it and how to redeem it
Anchored fiat assets need a transfer server to be redeemed
Stellar asset codes must be 1 to 12 characters long
Each currency needs a code or code_template
Collateral address, message, and signature lists must line up
display_decimals must be an integer from 0 to 7, and has no meaning on the native asset
A Soroban contract decimals value should match display_decimals
Warn when display_decimals exceeds 7 for classic assets
Classic assets must not declare more than 7 display decimals during network checks
The same code and issuer pair must not appear twice
CURRENCIES must be a list of tables
status and anchor_asset_type must use the values SEP-1 defines
Stellar asset codes must contain only alphanumeric ASCII characters
Include exactly one of fixed_number, max_number, or is_unlimited
A currency needs exactly one of issuer (Stellar asset) or contract (SEP-41 token)
An asset-anchored currency should declare its anchor asset code
An asset-anchored currency must declare a valid anchor_asset_type
name must be at most 20 characters
regulated = true applies only to classic issued assets, not native XLM or contracts
A SEP-8 issuer authorization flags could not be verified against Horizon
A SEP-8 regulated issuer must set AUTH_REQUIRED_FLAG so the issuer controls who may hold the asset
A SEP-8 regulated issuer should set AUTH_REVOCABLE_FLAG so unauthorized holders can be frozen
A regulated asset (SEP-8) requires an approval_server
A currency using the toml pointer must specify no other fields
Flags currency fields SEP-1 does not define
Currency URL fields must be valid, and approval_server must use https://
Attestation URLs must be on the same domain as ORG_URL
Organization emails must be well formed and correctly hosted
ORG_LICENSE_NUMBER requires ORG_LICENSING_AUTHORITY
ORG_URL must match the domain hosting the file (needs --domain)
ORG_PHONE_NUMBER should be in E.164 format
A [DOCUMENTATION] table should be present
Fields wallets weigh when deciding whether to list an asset
Social fields should hold bare handles, not URLs
Flags [DOCUMENTATION] fields SEP-1 does not define
ORG_URL and attestation URLs must use https://
stellar.toml must not exceed 100KB
ACCOUNTS must be a list of valid G... account IDs
WEB_AUTH_ENDPOINT (SEP-10) requires SIGNING_KEY
Flags deprecated SEP-1 fields and legacy configuration forms
ORG_OFFICIAL_EMAIL domain must have MX records for email deliverability
Flags empty string values in organization and documentation fields
HORIZON_URL must be a valid URL
Endpoint fields must be https:// URLs
ORG_GITHUB must be a valid GitHub username or profile URL
KYC_SERVER (SEP-12) requires WEB_AUTH_ENDPOINT (SEP-10)
Stellar account public keys (SIGNING_KEY, issuer, PUBLIC_KEY) must be uppercase
TRANSFER_SERVER_SEP0024 (SEP-24) requires WEB_AUTH_ENDPOINT (SEP-10)
DIRECT_PAYMENT_SERVER (SEP-31) requires KYC_SERVER (SEP-12)
ANCHOR_QUOTE_SERVER (SEP-38) requires WEB_AUTH_ENDPOINT (SEP-10)
SEP-45 web auth needs both an endpoint and a contract ID
SIGNING_KEY and URI_REQUEST_SIGNING_KEY must be valid G... account IDs
Service endpoint URLs must not end with a trailing slash
A declared transfer server should have a non-empty [[CURRENCIES]] list
Flags top-level fields SEP-1 does not define
VERSION should be present and look like a semantic version
WEB_AUTH_CONTRACT_ID must be a valid C... contract ID
History checkpoint hashes must form an unbroken previous-ledger chain
History archives must publish complete category data for the latest three checkpoints
Service endpoints must answer OPTIONS requests with valid CORS origin and methods
HORIZON_URL core must support the network current protocol version
HORIZON_URL must respond with a valid Horizon root document
Service endpoints should return Access-Control-Allow-Headers for browser pre-flight requests
ORG_URL must be a reachable HTTPS endpoint with valid TLS
NETWORK_PASSPHRASE must exactly match a known Stellar network
TRANSFER_SERVER GET /info should answer 200 and be reachable
TRANSFER_SERVER GET /info should return a JSON object with asset maps
Every non-native [[CURRENCIES]] asset should appear in the /info maps
Overlay messages must use valid big-endian framing and monotonic session sequences
Overlay validators must report at least one reachable peer
Overlay validators should report more than five peers
Overlay message authentication tags must verify against their session keys
PRINCIPALS must be a list of tables
Identity photo hashes must be hex-encoded SHA-256 digests
Each principal should give a name and a business email
Principal social fields should hold bare handles, not URLs
Flags principal fields SEP-1 does not define
Host must not negotiate a deprecated TLS protocol version
DNS resolvers must agree on the anchor domain A and AAAA records
DNS responses should be authenticated by validating recursive resolvers
Host must not negotiate a weak cipher suite
SEP-12 customer type names must be lowercase identifiers
KYC_SERVER customer schemas should require SEP-9 field names
ANCHOR_QUOTE_SERVER GET /prices must return JSON carrying a buy_assets array
ANCHOR_QUOTE_SERVER /quote must return a JSON quote object when it answers 200
ANCHOR_QUOTE_SERVER GET /prices must answer 200 with a SEP-38 price object
ANCHOR_QUOTE_SERVER /quote must not answer with a 5xx server error
A Soroban contract or its WASM has expired or been archived on the network
A Soroban contract or its WASM is within ~a day of its TTL expiring
A Soroban contract TTL could not be verified against the Soroban RPC
WEB_AUTH_CONTRACT_ID must export the SEP-45 web_auth_verify function
ALIAS must match ^[a-z0-9-]{2,16}$ so stellar-core configs accept it
ALIAS must not be a reserved stellar-core config keyword (self, all, default, none, quorum, peers, manual, auto)
ALIAS values should be unique across validators
HOST values should be unique across validators
PUBLIC_KEY values must be unique across validators
VALIDATORS must be a list of tables
HOST must be a host:port peers can dial
HISTORY must be a well-formed archive URL with a valid {0} template
PUBLIC_KEY must be a valid G... account ID and unique per node
History archives must serve .well-known/stellar-history.json with "version": 1
Flags validator fields SEP-1 does not define
